name: Mahou Tou Shoujo Suzune
source:
Suzune fairly and squarely introduced herself as a heroine of justice.
On the other hand, the lead character is a talent-less and incapable of shooting her with a gun.
Then, he thought, "I may use my lust as a weapon?"

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063533.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
铃音公正而正经地介绍自己是正义的女主角。
另一方面，主角是个没有天赋的人，无法用枪射击她。
然后他想：“我可以用我的欲望作为武器吗？”

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063533.html]DLsite English[/url]]
